summary: An eight-track groovebox firmware aimed at sound design, where synth, strike and drum tracks play, excite and reshape one another through an influence grid.
features: Fifteen synth engines, including a Casio CZ, PPG-style WAVE, ORGAN and GUITAR
Strike tracks and 33 Machinedrum-style perc machines
"WEFT" patchable voice and a four-lane "GLITCH LOOPER"
8 x 8 influence grid for cross-track modulation, triggering and excitation
Step or graph sequencer per track, with locks, ratchets, conditions
MIDI in over USB and TRS with clock; young firmware, back up projects
